title: Red Comet
summary: The Red Comet was a comet which gave a lot of power to the Blood Spiral, and it can only be seen by Seekers. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] It also served as a beacon for Nullifiers, signaling the re-emergence of the Blood Spiral. [Chasing Void] If it hits the Spiral Mark, it would bring the Nullifiers back.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
As the [[Quatrains of Nostradamus|Nostradamus quatrain]]<ref>The quatrain read: ''On the island of kings to the North'' / ''Burning lamps call the dragon's breath'' / ''A sword saves the future queen'' / ''But the red eye will shine on the world''</ref> the Huntik team found at the [[Tower of Nostradamus]] predicted, the Red Comet started shining after [[Lok Lambert]] first used the [[Willblade]] to save [[Sophie Casterwill]] on the island of [[Avalon]]. {{Source|Knight of the Willblade}}

Lok unwillingly changed it course to Earth when he struck the [[Willblade]] in the sealed Mark, after being led by the false quatrains to think that doing so would stop the return of the Nullifiers. When [[Rassimov]] tried to take the power of the Red Comet for himself, it killed him. It was stopped later by [[Dante Vale]] using [[Copykind]] on both [[Maelstrom]] and [[Phoenix]]. {{Source|The Spiral Mark}}

History

[Knight of the Willblade]

Lok unwillingly changed it course to Earth when he struck the Willblade in the sealed Mark, after being led by the false quatrains to think that doing so would stop the return of the Nullifiers. When Rassimov tried to take the power of the Red Comet for himself, it killed him. It was stopped later by Dante Vale using Copykind on both Maelstrom and Phoenix. [The Spiral Mark]
